definitions.gloss: sky blue; azure; light blue like the sky
definitions.explanation: A light, clear blue color resembling the sky on a sunny day. One of the traditional Japanese color names.

examples.japanese: {空色|そらいろ}のワンピースを{着|き}た。
{壁|かべ}を{空色|そらいろ}に{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I repainted the wall sky blue.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{見|み}える{空色|そらいろ}のグラデーションが{美|うつく}しく、しばらく{見|み}とれていた。
examples.english: The gradation of sky blue visible from the window was so beautiful that I gazed at it for a while.

notes:
A compound of {空|そら} (sky) and {色|いろ} (color). One of the traditional Japanese color names ({和色|わしょく}), referring to the clear light blue of a fair-weather sky. It can function as an adjective with の (e.g., {空色|そらいろ}の{花|はな}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空色|そらいろ}の{花|はな}: sky-blue flowers
- {空色|そらいろ}の{目|め}: sky-blue eyes
- {空色|そらいろ}に{染|そ}まる: to be dyed sky blue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水色|みずいろ}: light blue — very similar shade; {水色|みずいろ} is the more common everyday term for light blue
- {青|あお}: blue — the general term for blue; covers a wider range of shades
- {紺色|こんいろ}: dark blue; navy — a much darker blue than {空色|そらいろ}
- {藍色|あいいろ}: indigo — a deep blue-purple traditional color
